run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-15T01:41:20Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert is explained by checkout's own PlaceOrder errors: in 01:41:20–02:21:35, checkout recorded 866.03 error spans on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and on its HTTP POST client span (861.58 in the 40m scan), against 2022.08 non-error PlaceOrder spans — roughly 13–44% of PlaceOrder spans per 5-minute bucket. Every failing PlaceOrder carries the exact status description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400' (rpc.grpc.status_code 13) and aborts inside prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart, right after oteldemo.CartService/GetCart succeeds and its HTTP POST client span is marked error. In the full trace of a failure, that HTTP POST span's only visible child is shipping's server span /get-quote (31–469 µs, no status tags), and no further spans follow — no payment, email, ship-order or quote spans. In healthy traces the same POST has a shipping 'POST quote' child and a quote 'POST /getquote' child, and the email POST later returns http.status_code 200. Over the window shipping handled 2803.73 /get-quote spans but only 1943.07 'POST quote' client spans: the ~860 difference matches checkout's 866 failing orders, i.e. those requests returned without the quote call ever being made. The failing checkouts also show no oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and no oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert calls under prepareOrderItems (3118.31 GetProduct and 5139.38 Convert against 2022.08 successful orders = 1.54 and 2.54 per successful order, none for the failing ones), which points to item-less quote requests. Every other candidate dependency is clean on its own telemetry: payment, currency, cart, product-catalog, quote, email, accounting and shipping produced no STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans in the window, quote logs 'Calculated quote' continuously, observed email responses were 200, and all 21 otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts. The unresolved part is the deepest one: shipping's actual HTTP response status is not recorded on any span (the '400' exists only inside checkout's error string), so why shipping rejected ~860 /get-quote calls — item-less request versus another validation — is inferred, not proven, and the message's wording 'email service' is not supported by any email evidence.

claims.text: In 01:41:20–02:21:35 checkout had STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans only on span_name 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (866.03, 40-minute increase evaluated 02:21:20) and on span_name 'HTTP POST' (861.58); its nine other series (e.g. 'oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge', 'oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert', 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct', 'orders publish', 'prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart') show no error series.

The same window's error scan shows the blast radius of the same failure: frontend 'POST /api/checkout' 859.65, frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 859.65, frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 859.65, frontend 'POST' 649.04; payment, currency, cart, product-catalog, email, shipping, quote and accounting have no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series (only ad 3.06, fraud-detection 3.05 and recommendation 4.05 flagd EventStream errors appear, unrelated to checkout).

Checkout's failing server spans carry the exact diagnostics otel.status_description and exception.message 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400' with otel.status_code ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code '13' (span f87dd56e45d7bf38, service_version 2.1.3).

In trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231 the failure aborts at the shipping-quote step: PlaceOrder span f87dd56e45d7bf38 has child prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart 4e53d77d5e11686f, which has oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (rpc.grpc.status_code '0') and checkout's 'HTTP POST' span 2f69d09d57973cd9 (error=true, 826 µs); that POST's only visible child is shipping's server span /get-quote a170b05e15f5aeba (469 µs, no status tags). No email, payment, ship-order or quote span exists anywhere in that 15-span trace.

The healthy path of the same call looks different: in traces 3ae568525a98cdcea9769a3703e954d8 and 8e42cf2d98d4fb8a102ab6a2cd3b8747 shipping /get-quote (2647 µs / 1965 µs) has child 'POST quote' (2509 µs / 1845 µs), which has child quote 'POST /getquote' (430 µs / 312 µs), and checkout's separate 'HTTP POST' → email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' returns http.status_code 200.

Forty-minute span counts (all STATUS_CODE_UNSET, no error series) are shipping '/get-quote' 2803.73 versus shipping 'POST quote' 1943.07, quote 'POST /getquote' 1945.31, email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' 1940.24, shipping '/ship-order' 1944.30 — so about 860 /get-quote calls produced no quote call at all.

In the 5-minute slice 01:45:00–01:50:00 the shipping pod logged exactly 255 'Requesting quote' lines and exactly 255 'Sending Quote' lines, i.e. every quote request the handler logged was also answered with a quote; the fast-failing requests visible in traces (e.g. 01:45:58.586394Z, 01:45:14.7867957Z, 01:45:02.170294Z) have no matching 'Requesting quote' line in that slice.

The three failing traces selected via shipping /get-quote with max_duration 800us (fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231, adb3c50d1d124cff7b898569d2f8feba, 7ca0fe45d87843d44530943dfd48166d) all show the same shape: shipping /get-quote 31–469 µs with no children, checkout 'HTTP POST' error ~0.8–1.2 ms, and a prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart span containing only oteldemo.CartService/GetCart plus that POST — no oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and no oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert.

Checkout's 40-minute span counts are consistent with zero item preparation on the failing orders: PlaceOrder 2022.08 UNSET + 866.03 ERROR, 'HTTP POST' 6064.23 UNSET + 866.03 ERROR (≈3 POSTs per successful order, 1 per failing order), oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 2887.10 (≈1 per order), but oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 3118.31 (1.54 per successful order) and oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 5139.38 (2.54 per successful order).

The error rate stayed high across the window: 5-minute increases of checkout PlaceOrder ERROR spans read 4.9 (sample 01:43:20), 70, 140, 140, 150, 121.1, 107.8, 131.1, 123.3, 44.4, 47.8, 77.8, 83.8 (sample 02:19:20) against UNSET 177–309 per bucket, i.e. roughly 13–44% of PlaceOrder spans per bucket; the finer query shows the first sample of this series at 01:41:30 (0) then 6, 2, 16, 36, 72 errors per minute.

Kubernetes pod state shows no pod-level damage: all 21 otel-demo pods are Running and Ready with 0 restarts; checkout, shipping, quote and email pods all started 2026-11-15T01:31:11Z (before the alert at 01:41:20Z), flagd at 01:33:02Z, load-generator at 02:05:26Z.

Service routing configuration is consistent with the observed call graph: checkout has SHIPPING_ADDR=http://shipping:8080 and EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080, shipping has QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, and all four deployments run ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-<service> images with 1 replica.

The flagd configuration (configmap flagd-config, demo.flagd.json) has every failure flag 'off' except loadGeneratorFloodHomepage with defaultVariant '100'; there is no flag for shipping, quote or email behaviour, so no configured failure flag explains the checkout quote errors.

Primary hypothesis: shipping's /get-quote handler rejects quote requests that carry no cart items with HTTP 400 before calling the quote service. Support: the failing checkouts show no GetProduct/Convert work under prepareOrderItems (1.54 and 2.54 calls per successful order, none for failing ones), shipping produced the /get-quote span in 31–469 µs without any 'POST quote' child or 'Requesting quote' log line, and the ~860 missing quote calls match checkout's 866 failing orders. Not proven because request bodies and shipping's response status are not observable.

Second hypothesis, unresolved: the item-less quote requests originate in the load-generator's checkout tasks (both user_checkout_single and user_checkout_multi appear as roots of failing traces) checking out carts that hold no items, e.g. a user whose cart was already emptied by a prior successful checkout (oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart is part of every successful order). No user ids or cart payloads are visible in the evidence, so the source of the empty carts cannot be confirmed.

Rejected as the failing dependency: the email service returning 400. Although the exact error text names the email service, the failing checkout HTTP POST span's only child is shipping's /get-quote server span, failing traces contain no email span at all, and the email spans that were observed returned http.status_code 200 (POST /send_order_confirmation, 3357 µs and 4206 µs). The email service therefore shows no observed 400 and no error span; the wording 'email service' inside checkout's message remains unexplained.

The downstream services named as candidates did not fail on their own telemetry: payment Charge spans (rpc.grpc.status_code '0'), currency Convert spans (otel.status_code 'OK'), cart GetCart/EmptyCart spans (rpc.grpc.status_code '0') and product-catalog GetProduct spans (rpc.grpc.status_code '0') are all clean, quote recorded 1945.31 POST /getquote spans with no error series and its pod logged 'Calculated quote' continuously through 02:16:15Z.

Confirm at the source what shipping's /get-quote returns for an item-less quote request (checkout and shipping request/response logging or the service code), then fix the mismatch: either have checkout reject an empty cart as a client error without calling the quote endpoint, or have shipping/quote answer an empty item list with a 200 zero quote instead of 400. Also correct the misleading 'failed POST to email service' wording in checkout's shipping-quote error path.

gaps: The exact HTTP status returned by shipping's /get-quote is not recorded on any span (the failing checkout client span carries only error=true/otel.status_code=ERROR); the value 400 is known only from checkout's error string, so the reason for the rejection is inferred, not observed.
No request/response payloads, cart contents or user ids are available, so the item-less-request explanation for the 400 could not be verified directly.

The wording 'email service' inside the exact error message could not be explained: no email span exists in failing traces and observed email responses were 200; the checkout/shipping source or container images were not readable in this Run.

The checkout error series has its first sample at 01:41:30 (1-minute query) / 01:41:20 (window start), so I cannot establish the true onset of the errors or whether they predate the alert; the alert payload states 01:41:20Z.

The Prometheus alert rule 'RequestErrorRate' is not present in this Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules for that name returned no data), so the alert's exact expression/threshold and whether the reported 0.2 is a ratio or a count could not be verified.

The email container produced no log lines in any window queried, so the email service's behaviour could not be corroborated from logs; kube_pod_container_info returned no data, so pod image digests could not be compared for a configuration-only deployment.

Kubernetes events returned no data in this namespace, so absence of OOM/eviction/backoff events during the window is unknown rather than confirmed; similarly, no change_history integration is available, so what changed around 01:31–01:41 (all pods restarted at 01:31:11–01:31:13) could not be determined.
next_steps: Review change history for namespace otel-demo around 2026-11-15T01:31–01:41 (deployment rollout, flagd config, load-generator restart at 02:05:26) to see whether shipping/quote behaviour or the checkout call path changed.

Capture one failing checkout request body and shipping's HTTP response on /get-quote (temporary debug logging or a packet capture on the checkout→shipping path) to confirm the empty-item-list hypothesis and the 400.
Compare image digests of the checkout, shipping, quote and email pods against the expected demo:2.1.3 images to rule out a configuration-only deployment.

If empty-cart checkouts are confirmed as the trigger, decide whether this is desired load-generator behaviour or a checkout/shipping validation bug before tuning or silencing the RequestErrorRate alert.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.

data.relay:
connectors:
  spanmetrics:
    dimensions:
    - default: otel-demo
      name: namespace
exporters:
  clickhouse:
    endpoint: http://clickhouse-clickhouse.clickhouse.svc.cluster.local:8123
    logs_table_name: otel_demo_logs
    password: ""
    traces_table_name: otel_demo_traces
    username: default
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch-master.opensearch.svc.cluster.local:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel-logs
    logs_index_time_format: yyyy-MM-dd
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector.opentelemetry-collectors.svc.cluster.local:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    endpoint: http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090
    tls:
      insecure: true
  prometheus:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:8889
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  resourcedetection:
    detectors:
    - env
    - system
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  nginx:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: http://image-provider:8081/status
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  postgresql:
    endpoint: postgresql:5432
    metrics:
      postgresql.blks_hit:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.blks_read:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.deadlocks:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_deleted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_fetched:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_inserted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_returned:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_updated:
        enabled: true
    password: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
    tls:
      insecure: true
    username: root
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
    username: valkey
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - debug
      - prometheus
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - nginx
      - otlp
      - postgresql
      - redis
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - pull:
          exporter:
            prometheus:
              host: 0.0.0.0
              port: 8888

Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.
